mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), and Test Readiness Review (TRR)."
Examples of formal reviews are the Preliminary Design Review (PDR), Critical Design Review (CDR), and Test Readiness Review (TRR).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those factors that can readily be observed by the user, (e.g. speed, reliability, correctness, usability)."
External quality factors are those factors that can readily be observed by the user, (e.g. speed, reliability, correctness, usability).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sequence of instruction which the computer follows to perform a given task."
A program itself is a sequence of instruction which the computer follows to perform a given task.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any type of software testing that seeks to reveal clash of individual software modules to each other."
Integration testing is any type of software testing that seeks to reveal clash of individual software modules to each other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a programming paradigm that uses "objects" to design applications and computer programs."
Object-oriented programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm that uses "objects" to design applications and computer programs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a course that intends to provide concept of the discipline and is concerned with application of engineering to software."
Software Engineering is a course that intends to provide concept of the discipline and is concerned with application of engineering to software.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the all-inclusive process that includes all aspects of software requirements analysis and as well ensures verification, validation and traceability of requirements."

Requirements Management Requirements Management is the all-inclusive process that includes all aspects of software requirements analysis and as well ensures verification, validation and traceability of requirements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an SQA activity that assures standards are being followed."
Product evaluation is an SQA activity that assures standards are being followed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a high-level IPO chart that summarizes the inputs to, processes or tasks performed by, and outputs from a module."
An overview diagram is a high-level IPO chart that summarizes the inputs to, processes or tasks performed by, and outputs from a module.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a class of software which the user of computer needs to accomplish one or more definite tasks."
Application software Application software is a class of software which the user of computer needs to accomplish one or more definite tasks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known but the occurrence of the error does not notably affect the system's expected quality."
A non-critical error is known but the occurrence of the error does not notably affect the system's expected quality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to evaluate an application/system's performance in connection to the database it will interact with."
Database compatibility testing is used to evaluate an application/system's performance in connection to the database it will interact with.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a detailed examination of a product on a step-by-step or line-of-code by line-of-code basis to find errors."
An inspection or walkthrough is a detailed examination of a product on a step-by-step or line-of-code by line-of-code basis to find errors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of CASE tools and workbenches that supports the software process."
An environment is a collection of CASE tools and workbenches that supports the software process.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an audit report to management consisting of findings and recommendations to bring the development into conformance with standards and/or procedures."
The SQA product is an audit report to management consisting of findings and recommendations to bring the development into conformance with standards and/or procedures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any type of software testing that attempts to reveal software regressions."
Regression testing is any type of software testing that attempts to reveal software regressions.
